'''T'liha i'Ora''' was an individual who donated 50 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to the [[Lightwind Orphanage]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Behind the scenes==
T'liha i'Ora was mentioned in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a massively multiplayer online role-playing game developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
